product_metadata.title: Sleeping Dog Cast Iron Wood Stove Steamer with Matte Black Enamel Finish, Rust Resistant - A Decorative Functional Alternative to Electric Humidifiers - 2.75 Quart Capacity
features: HEAVY CAST IRON - Durable, long-lasting steamer retains heat and withstands high temperatures even if empty
PORCELAIN ENAMEL MATTE FINISH - Coated inside and out to resist rust and chipping, easy to keep clean
MOISTURIZES & HUMIDIFIES - Healthy steam puffs out the campfire to make winter air more comfortable
FUNCTIONAL & DECORATIVE - Unique solution to a common problem; makes a great conversation piece and gift
LARGE CAPACITY - Top-filling pot with removable lid holds 2-3/4 quarts of water; add potpourri for aromatherapy
description: The Dog by Campfire Wood Stove Steamer by Plow & Hearth is a unique way to add healthful moisture to dry winter air. Place this cast iron steamer on your stovetop, fill with water, and let it bring relief as steam puffs from the campfire. This large capacity steamer with removable lid holds approx. 2-3/4 qts. of water, so it won’t run dry when left on your stove overnight, and it doesn't need refilling as frequently. The durable cast iron design features a matte porcelain enamel finish inside and out to resist rust, make cleanup easier, and maintain its appearance. An energy-efficient alternative to electric humidifiers, our long-lasting cast iron steamer is an easy, low-tech way to combat dry winter air, relieve allergies and asthma symptoms, and create a more comfortable living environment for people, pets and plants. Add potpourri or essential oils for a pleasant fragrance and aromatherapy. The whimsical design of a sleeping dog curled up next to a cozy campfire adds a charming touch to your wood burning stove in any season - it makes a great conversation piece, as well as a unique gift! This wood stove accessory also works with pellet stoves, coal stoves and corn-burning stoves. No assembly required. Size: 2-3/4 QT - 12 L x 7 W x 6 H.
